items.text: Lamar Jackson (high-ankle sprain) has missed three straight games. Rapoport says he is likely to return and CBS's Tracy Wolfson reported he will play in Week 8; coach Jesse Minter said 'we'll know a lot more on Wednesday.' The schedule data lists Tyler Huntley, so the model uses Jackson; revisit if he doesn't practice.

Baltimore: OLB Tavius Robinson (pectoral) is out for the season; DL Broderick Washington Jr. (ankle) has missed two games; centers Ethan Pocic and Jovaughn Gwyn are on IR. Rookie RG Vega Ioane (knee) left Week 7 early, and G Andrew Vorhees (foot) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) missed the game.

Buffalo (off a bye): WR DJ Moore (shoulder) and DT Ed Oliver (knee) could return after the bye per Joe Brady; TE Dalton Kincaid (ribs) is questionable. S C.J. Gardner-Johnson is suspended for this game.
